I spent the night researching the Blackwood. Harrowgate. Moloch Rising. The deity demanded sacrifice, the texts claimed, appeased by grief. The wood grew on land once consecrated to him. eath left old Elias in the village below, the parchment disintegrated. It didn't burn; it simply became salt, scattering into the gale.

"It's happening again," I whispered, my fingers grasping at nothing but grit. The weight of the history I thought I protected was slipping through my hands.

"The Ars Memoria knows what you do not, child."
